## Services Offered

- **Concrete Driveways** — Durable driveway installation and full replacement. Standard and decorative finishes available. ([/services/concrete-driveways](https://murrietaconcreteworks.com/services/concrete-driveways))
- **Patios & Walkways** — Custom concrete patios, pathways, and pool decks designed for outdoor living in SoCal's climate. ([/services/patios-walkways](https://murrietaconcreteworks.com/services/patios-walkways))
- **Concrete Repair** — Crack injection, mudjacking, and resurfacing for heaved, cracked, or settled concrete. ([/services/concrete-repair](https://murrietaconcreteworks.com/services/concrete-repair))
- **Decorative Concrete** — Stamped, stained, and exposed-aggregate concrete for enhanced curb appeal. ([/services/decorative-concrete](https://murrietaconcreteworks.com/services/decorative-concrete))
